about: Stripe operations served for the application calls at the cited lines in demand.json and for the resource refresh reads declared in src/manifest.ts. The Dashboard customer pages read those same resource views, as declared in src/manifest.ts and customer-life.outline.md. All other operations answer the gap. Each decision names its caller or refresh and its implementation.

Stripe's action beyond the core's plain one (semantics/account_links.ts): Creates an AccountLink object that includes a single-use Stripe URL that the platform can redirect their user to in order to take them through the Connect Onboarding flow.
the requested capabilities become Stripe's status map, and settings its canonical shape
a single-use Express dashboard link, not stored
Stripe's create beyond the core's plain one (semantics/apps.ts): Create or replace a secret in the secret store.
Stripe's action beyond the core's plain one (semantics/apps.ts): Deletes a secret from the secret store by name and scope.
Stripe's create beyond the core's plain one (semantics/billing_portal.ts): Creates a configuration that describes the functionality and behavior of a PortalSession
the configuration defaults to the account's default one
Stripe's create beyond the core's plain one (semantics/checkout.ts): Creates a Checkout Session object.
Stripe's create beyond the core's plain one (semantics/coupons.ts): You can create coupons easily via the coupon management page of the Stripe dashboard.

Stripe's create beyond the core's plain one (semantics/customers.ts): Creates a new customer object. A nonzero initial balance records an initial customer balance transaction (https://docs.stripe.com/billing/customer/balance).

Updates customer fields and records a balance delta as an immutable adjustment transaction: all modifications to the invoice balance are recorded as Transactions (https://docs.stripe.com/billing/customer/balance).
a new invoice pulls in the customer's pending items only when asked: pending_invoice_items_behavior "Defaults to `exclude` if the parameter is omitted" (docs.stripe.com/api/invoices/create)

A preview of the next invoice for a customer or subscription (create_preview), computed and never stored: the subscription's items at their prices, the customer's pending items, the subscription's discount, and with `subscription_details.proration_date` a credit for the unused period against a charge for the new one (split evenly: there is no clock here to measure the remaining fraction).

paying charges a payment method (the one passed, the invoice's default, or the customer's) unless the payment is recorded out of band; a declining card answers 402 and leaves the invoice open. A paid invoice settles the PaymentIntent finalize opened, and names the charge that took the money.
Stripe's action beyond the core's plain one (semantics/invoices.ts): Mark a finalized invoice as void.
an action: the pending authorization approved (still pending, funds held from the Issuing balance), a decided one refused authorization_already_finalized
an action: the pending authorization declined and closed, a decided one refused
the derived core's create of issuing.cardholder: a plain create the manifest's declaration serves

a create the core cannot make: the card answers its cardholder in full, its last4 from a number drawn from the World, Visa, three years' expiry, inactive unless the create names a status (the spec's default), spending controls normalized
The card status enum and normalized spending controls are checked before writing the vendor card (spec:PostIssuingCardsCard).
Stripe's create beyond the core's plain one (semantics/payment_intents.ts): Creates a PaymentIntent object.

Stripe's action beyond the core's plain one (semantics/payment_intents.ts): You can cancel a PaymentIntent object when it’s in one of these statuses: requires_payment_method, requires_capture, requires_confirmation, requires_action or, in rare cases, processing.
Stripe's action beyond the core's plain one (semantics/payment_methods.ts): Detaches a PaymentMethod object from a Customer.
Stripe's create beyond the core's plain one (semantics/payouts.ts): To send funds to your own bank account, create a new payout object.
Stripe's create beyond the core's plain one (semantics/prices.ts): Creates a new Price for an existing Product.
Stripe's create beyond the core's plain one (semantics/products.ts): Creates a new product object.
a code the caller does not give is derived from the promotion code's id
the derived core's update of promotion_code: a move the resource's state machine (semantics/states.ts) allows, or a plain update
Stripe's create beyond the core's plain one (semantics/radar.ts): Creates a new ValueListItem object, which is added to the specified parent value list.
Stripe's create beyond the core's plain one (semantics/refunds.ts): When you create a new refund, you must specify a Charge or a PaymentIntent object on which to create it.
Stripe's update beyond the core's plain one (semantics/subscriptions.ts): Updates an existing subscription to match the specified parameters.
The product World presents the merchant authorization; validates the card, spending controls and available Issuing funds, and asks the enrolled real-time endpoint.
The product World captures the approved authorization; releases its hold and records the transaction and Issuing ledger debit.
Stripe's create beyond the core's plain one (semantics/transfers.ts): To send funds from your Stripe account to a connected account, you create a new transfer object.
a create the core cannot make: the endpoint's own signing secret drawn from the World, answered at creation only (the around strips it from every other read)
